ranged_attack.name: Lightning Call
ranged_attack.windup: plants his feet, glares at {target} and raises his war hammer high to the sky with both hands, blue sparks crackling along its head
ranged_attack.release: brings the hammer down to point at {target} as its head flashes bright blue-white
ranged_attack.travel: a jagged branching bolt of blue-white lightning splits the sky and strikes straight down onto {target}
ranged_attack.impact: it crashes onto {target} in a blinding white flash and a ring of crackling blue sparks across the ground
ranged_attack.decay: the lightning vanishes in an instant, leaving {target} in plain view
ranged_attack.again: raises his hammer again and calls down another jagged blue-white lightning bolt that flashes onto {target} and vanishes at once
ranged_attack.text: raises his war hammer to the sky, blue sparks crackling along its head, and calls a jagged blue-white lightning bolt down onto {target} in a blinding flash that vanishes at once

melee_attack.name: Thunder Hammer
melee_attack.windup: steps in and heaves his war hammer up over his head with both hands, blue lightning crackling along its head
melee_attack.impact: the hammer slams down into {target} with a thunderclap and a blinding blue-white burst of forked lightning
melee_attack.decay: the lightning dies away at once
melee_attack.recover: swings the hammer back to his side as the last sparks fade
melee_attack.again: slams his crackling hammer into {target} again in a blinding blue-white burst that dies away at once
melee_attack.text: heaves his war hammer overhead and slams it into {target} with a thunderclap of blinding blue-white lightning that dies away at once

dash.name: Storm Charge
dash.text: charges forward with heavy pounding steps, bright blue lightning crackling around him
